name: FAST -- Session / Opening-Range Behavior

exits: time exit at the first 5m boundary >= entry fill + 60 min
operationalization.rule: Opening range = max/min of MID highs/lows over [open, open+30m). After the window, on the first completed 5m bar within the next 60 min whose close is beyond the range: LONG above, SHORT below. One trade per pair per session-day. Skip if range width is outside [0.5, 3.0] x ATR14(15m).
operationalization.stop: opposite range boundary, but at least 1.0 x ATR14(15m); skip if the distance exceeds 2.5 x ATR14(15m)

source_registry.original_signal_definition: CONCEPT ONLY: price behavior in a defined window after a session open (e.g. London open, NY open) has a distinct distribution from the general base rate. No formula frozen.
source_registry.required_data: 1-minute canonical FX bars plus session labels.
